notes: The prompt says obby, so Obby & Platformer and its genre-wide P6. The answers ask for a compact course that climbs from the ocean floor toward the surface, which is real vertical gain with nothing said about platforms wrapping back over each other, so course-terraced rather than the flat default or course-tower — that adds tiered to the route and avoids the P2 a tower would force. I kept Classic Obby but substituted its course-flat shape for course-terraced, because the answers explicitly ask for one continuous easy-to-medium run with checkpoints, which is the preset's option set exactly, and only its shape was contradicted; winner-zone puts the payoff at the surface, where the climb ends. Without a user I treated the sea as theme rather than geometry — the answer has the player walking a dry seabed with the ocean as backdrop, so I did not add water-body, which would have put a volumetric CHECK on a build that is really a single climbing surface under a painted ocean.
